paragraphs.text: The Fields of Strife are located in the Tor-Kathorra Desert in the Southwest Region of Orrithia, on the plane of Arcavios . They are the site of a perpetual battle waged by restless spirits of the Blood Age.

Time for the restless spirits appears to pass asynchronously and nonlinearly. While the spirits were all participants in the same larger conflict, they could be from any number of skirmishes that occurred in the region over the course of several decades. So many have fallen here over so long a span that the remnants of their spirits can do nothing but continue the fight. The Fields are the only location on Arcavios where primary sources on the Blood Age are still available. They also feature almost hypnotic underlying mana currents that draw observers into the battle, eventually turning them into restless spirits themselves. The magical mechanisms for the spirits' continual animation are the subject of constant study and debate within Lorehold, which has established several semi-permanent camps.

At the very edge of the fields, a base camp has been established overlooking a shattered and lifeless expanse, where heat shimmers endlessly above the spectral forms of the dead locked in ceaseless combat. Those who linger risk being drawn into that endless struggle themselves; more than a few aspiring scholars have vanished during past expeditions, often enough to demand strict precautions. Protective wards have been laid down, and now the copper rods that anchor them pulse and crackle with a faint, otherworldly energy, holding the restless dead at bay, if only for a time. Deeper into the Fields, the ghosts fighting are stronger than the ones around the edges, with older and crisper memories. Beyond an intangible boundary which students are forbidden from crossing, the ghosts are still so angry that they cannot be pacified.
Armory Arch - One of the largest and most impressive star arches, it was formed from an ancient armory.

Camp Herrian - Named after one of the first deans of Strixhaven and located on the outskirts of the battle. Several semi-permanent structures are built into existing ruins, providing a place for relaxation, study, and preparation.
Lost Barracks - The hypnotic undercurrent of the region seems exaggerated in this area, so much so that the barracks are now considered off-limits to students.

Pranticle Peak - A mesa outcropping that offers excellent views of the fields for those who can reach the top. It was the site of one of the most famous battles that occurred on the Fields of Strife between Kor and owlin forces.
The Fields of Strife were formed during the Blood Age of Arcavios, an especially bloody period of the plane spanning millennia, whose battles were concentrated most strongly in this area.

In 4565 AR, secured the approval of Dean Augusta Tullus to secure a temporary position as a teaching assistant in order to join an expedition to the Fields of Strife. There, he conducted an independent investigation beyond established safety boundaries, repeatedly entering and withdrawing from hostile spectral memory fields. During this process, he uncovered a previously unknown subterranean cache of Blood Age artifacts after accidentally breaching its surface, reported the find, and returned with a geomancer assistant named Mica to document the site. Upon revisiting the location, he discovered evidence of prior intrusion by the off-plane looter Stella Lee , whom he confronted and repelled, and further investigation of the site revealed fossilized tracks and iconography consistent with entities linked to his Coin Empire hypothesis, confirming its historical presence on Arcavios and reinforcing his assessment of its broader significance.
